notes: Correction: this front page says the city was placed under martial law. The report of the army's Pacific Division states that its troops acted "in the nature of posse comitatus for the maintenance of public order", that "the proclamations and municipal orders of the Mayor should be strictly observed" (page 15), and that "the military force was to be strictly subordinate to the civil authorities" (page 18). Source: Maj. Gen. Adolphus W. Greely, Earthquake in California, April 18, 1906, Government Printing Office, 1906, public domain: https://archive.org/details/earthquakeincal00divigoog
